::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 7th 1882  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne,Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

Dear Madam

I am much obliged by your pretty book. It is an excellent thing to put forth what encreases interest in the mission field.

Yours truly
C M Yonge
